name: Keystroke
description: A dark, version-led changelog for an app on several platforms: the version in a red pill over the date in the gutter, platforms as a segmented switch, every release in full under New, Improvements and Fixes, and key caps inline.
features: Index layout: gutter, version first (tinted red pill) then the date
Platforms as a segmented tag switch, each with its own page
Full release notes on the index, sectioned New / Improvements / Fixes
Beta channel badge; breaking releases lead with their upgrade notes
Numbered pages and an email subscribe band
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

attrs.heading: Never miss an update
attrs.body: Release notes in your inbox, once a week.

posts.title: Window snapping and a quicker clipboard
posts.markdown:
Snap any window to a half, a third or a corner with one shortcut, and find anything you copied this week in under a second.

### New

![The command bar with window layouts](/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103)

- **Window layouts** — press <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>←</kbd> to snap left; nine layouts in all.
- **Pinned clips** stay at the top of clipboard history until you unpin them.

### Improvements

- Clipboard search is four times faster on large histories.
- Settings open on the tab you used last.

### Fixes

- Fixed a crash when an extension returned an empty list.
- The command bar no longer opens on the wrong display.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Smoother scrolling in long lists
posts.markdown:
Lists with thousands of items now scroll at a steady frame rate, and the selection follows the keyboard without jumping.

### Improvements

- Images in lists load as they come into view.
- <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> shows the actions for the selected item.

### Fixes

- Fixed the search field losing focus after an action.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Now on Windows, in beta
posts.markdown:
The launcher is now available for Windows 11 as a public beta, with the same extensions and the same shortcuts.

### New

- Install from the website; updates arrive in the background.
- Press <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> to open it anywhere.

### Known issues

- Window layouts are not available yet on Windows.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Extensions API 2.0
posts.markdown:
The extensions API is now version 2.0: faster startup, typed preferences, and background refresh for menu bar commands.

## Upgrading

Extensions built against API 1.x keep working until the date below. Rebuild with the new CLI and replace `useCachedState` with `useLocalStorage`; the migration guide lists every renamed call.

### New

- Background refresh on an interval you choose.
- Typed preferences, checked when the extension loads.

Placeholder release notes.

Capture a note from the lock screen and find it on your Mac a second later.

### New

### Fixes
